{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Complete demerger by December and listing in Q4 FY2026",
      "made_in": "Oct 2025",
      "quote": "We expect to complete the demerger by December, with the listing anticipated in Quarter 4 of Financial Year 2026",
      "outcome": "Unverifiable. Management reported a one-time high PAT of Rs. 6,603 crores in Q3 FY26, but listing status is not explicitly confirmed in later reports.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Q3 FY26 call / Quarterly results Dec 2025"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Quick commerce to scale meaningfully in the near term",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "While it contributes around 3% of our business today, we expect it to scale meaningfully in the near term.",
      "outcome": "Unverifiable. Later reports do not provide a specific percentage for quick commerce contribution to verify scaling.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Q4 FY26 call / Q1 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Invest Rs. 2,000 crores capex in premium Beauty and Home Care",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "we have recently committed Rs. 2,000 crores of capex investments in premium formats of Beauty and Home Care.",
      "outcome": "Tracking. Commitment made for medium term; quarterly results show rising turnover but specific capex deployment is not yet reported.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Q1 FY27 call / Q2 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "FY27 performance will be better than FY26",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "we remain confident that FY'27 will be better than FY’26.",
      "outcome": "Tracking. H1 FY27 USG is 12% vs FY26 USG of 5%. Revenue growth reached 14% in Sep 2026 vs 8% in Mar 2026.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026 / Q2 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "EBITDA Margin to remain around current guided range",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "We, therefore, expect EBITDA Margin to remain around the current guided range.",
      "outcome": "Delivered. EBITDA margin was 23% in Jun 2026 and 22.6% in Sep 2026, staying within the guided range.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026 / Q2 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Medium-term EBITDA Margin between 22% to 24%",
      "made_in": "Nov 2026",
      "quote": "We expect medium-term EBITDA Margin to be within the current guided range of 22% to 24%.",
      "outcome": "Delivered. Reported EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026) was 22.6%, which is within the 22-24% range.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026 / Q2 FY27 call"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 2,
    "partly": 0,
    "missed": 0,
    "summary": "Management demonstrates high credibility by consistently delivering EBITDA margins within their 22-24% guided range while successfully accelerating revenue growth from 0% to 14% YoY.",
    "narrative_vs_numbers": [
      "Margin narrative aligns perfectly with reported OPM, which has stayed between 22% and 24% for nine consecutive quarters.",
      "Revenue growth narrative of 'better FY27' is supported by the jump from 5% USG in FY26 to 12% USG in H1 FY27.",
      "Volume growth narrative matches the data, showing an increase from 2% in Q2 FY26 to 7% in Q2 FY27."
    ]
  }
}
